title: Bank tellers with priority and a break
prompt:
Simulate a bank with 3 tellers, numbered 1 to 3, and a single waiting line. Time is counted in whole minutes. The customers, given as name, arrival minute, minutes of service needed and kind, are: ann 0 5 regular; bob 0 3 regular; cy 1 4 vip; dee 2 6 regular; eli 2 2 vip; fay 3 4 regular; gus 5 1 regular; hal 18 9 regular; ivy 19 3 vip; jon 20 4 regular; kim 20 5 vip; lou 22 4 regular; max 27 1 regular; ned 30 2 vip.
Rules:
- A vip customer joins the line ahead of every waiting regular customer, but behind the vip customers already waiting. A regular customer joins the end of the line.
- At each minute, things happen in this order: first, every customer whose service ends at this minute leaves, and their teller becomes free; then the customers arriving at this minute join the line, in the order listed above; then, as long as some teller can start serving and the line is not empty, the customer at the front of the line leaves it and goes to the free teller with the lowest number. A customer served from minute S for D minutes leaves at minute S + D.
- Teller 3 takes a break: it does not start serving anyone at minutes 20 to 29, both included (a customer it is serving when the break begins is served to the end normally).
Print one line per customer, in the order in which they start being served (customers who start at the same minute in the order in which they left the line): `S NAME teller T wait W end E`, where S is the minute the service starts, T the teller, W = S minus the arrival minute, and E the minute the service ends. Then print `total wait X, longest wait Y (NAME)`, the sum of all waits and the longest wait with that customer's name; if several customers share the longest wait, name the one listed first above.
